items.source: For given PDOutlineNode bookmark convert all sibling PDOutlineItem items into ParagraphManager.Paragraph instances under the parentParagraph. For each PDOutlineItem item, recursively call generateParagraphs(ParagraphManager.Paragraph, PDOutlineNode, Integer) to process its children items.
items.translation: 对于给定的 PDOutlineNode 书签，将其所有兄弟 PDOutlineItem 项转换为父段落 ParagraphManager.Paragraph 下的实例。对于每个 PDOutlineItem 项，递归调用 generateParagraphs(ParagraphManager.Paragraph, PDOutlineNode, Integer) 以处理其子项。

items.source: For given PDOutlineNode bookmark convert all sibling PDOutlineItem items into ParagraphManager.Paragraph instances under the parentParagraph.
items.translation: 对于给定的PDOutlineNode书签，将其所有兄弟PDOutlineItem项转换为ParagraphManager.Paragraph实例，并置于父段落下。

items.source:
The ParagraphManager class is responsible for managing the paragraphs and hierarchy of
a PDF document. It can process bookmarks and generate a structured tree of paragraphs,
representing the table of contents (TOC) of the PDF document.
items.translation: ParagraphManager 类负责管理 PDF 文档中的段落及其层级结构。它可以处理书签并生成一个结构化的段落树，以表示该 PDF 文档的目录（TOC）。

items.source: Represents a document paragraph metadata and hierarchy.
items.translation: 表示文档段落元数据及其层次结构。

items.source: Returns a tree of ParagraphManager.Paragraphs that represent the PDF document TOC.
items.translation: 返回一个由代表 PDF 文档目录的ParagraphManager.Paragraph组成的树。

items.source: parentParagraph - Root paragraph that the bookmark sibling items should be added to.
items.translation: parentParagraph - 书签同级项应添加到的根段落。
level - 当前目录大纲的嵌套深度级别。
